verdict: Pipeline is active; a staffing gap is the one thing holding back full scale-up.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Google Ads ran at a deliberately reduced budget — $1,085.39 total spend — while the team holds scale-up until your intake staffing seat is confirmed. Despite the lighter spend, ads still produced 11 conversions and 126 clicks, and your Google Business Profile drove 107 actions including 28 direct calls and 45 direction requests. Lead tracking through ad data is currently showing zero because of a measurement gap, not an absence of activity — your CRM recorded 41 opportunities created and 12 won over the same window, so real pipeline is moving. Confirming your intake owner by August 31 is the gate that unlocks the budget increase and the ad scale-up planned for October.

highlights.phrase: opportunities created in the last 28 days, with 12 already marked won
direct calls driven by your Google Business Profile this period
total ad spend this period, held intentionally while intake staffing is resolved

watch_item.issue: The intake owner role has been open since early July, and the speed-to-lead follow-up system is pointed at an empty seat — meaning inbound opportunities may not be reached quickly enough.
watch_item.fix: Confirming a replacement is the target for August 31; that single step clears the way for budget scale-up and full automation to go live.
